arguments.question: For NVDA over 21/63 sessions, use the latest FY2027 Q2 10-Q and earnings release to identify measured revenue mix, customer/concentration or geography exposure, demand/backlog/supply commitments, guidance and principal near-term risks. Assess whether issuer evidence quantifies exposure to hyperscaler AI-capex financing conditions. Cite primary evidence IDs; stop if the filings do not quantify that transmission or current valuation.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether issuer fundamentals support or constrain a relative assessment versus SPY/XLK and whether monetary-policy transmission can be tied to measured NVDA exposure.
